records.summary: Refreshed the XRP Insights public XRPL exchange-wallet dataset and corrected the reserve-incident interpretation. The page reports 22.37B XRP across 701 wallets/24 exchanges as of 2026-10-30 08:00 UTC, with same-wallet net change -234.9M over seven days and -146.1M over 30 days. Binance-specific same-wallet change is -173.2M 7d and -164.5M 30d; Coinbase is +1.1M 7d/+12.5M 30d; SBI VC Trade is 59.5M across two publicly attributed wallets, cold-labeled >99%, with -893K 7d/-10.5M 30d. This is new direct evidence of XRP exchange/custody infrastructure attributed to SBI VC Trade, but it is not proof of SBI Group proprietary holdings or customer liabilities. The dataset explicitly includes 488.4M non-customer wrapped reserves/funds (325.8M Binance-Peg, 151.4M cbXRP, 11.2M insurance/charity) and cold storage; it is not tradable float. The all-exchange -234.9M seven-day decline is not the Binance theft amount; Binance-specific same-wallet decline is -173.2M. The prior CryptoQuant approximately 220M reserve decline is a different provider series and wallet universe. The 233.46M five-wallet incident transfer is not reconciled to either aggregate series; no source-wallet crosswalk or same-time PoR/liability comparison exists. No market feature admitted and no forecast issued. Separately, the approval workflow produced a second push-event failure with zero jobs (run 41177519094) despite declaring workflow_dispatch only; no job logs exist and the root cause remains unknown.
